name: All-day calendar event updates omit clock times
reason: Go-only handwritten calendar-event form update; PATCH/PUT excluded in spec/excluded-routes.json and absent from Smithy/OpenAPI. Not part of the TypeScript modeled surface.

name: A 401 on an SDK form request is answered by a refresh and one resend
reason: Go-only handwritten calendar-event form update; PATCH/PUT excluded in spec/excluded-routes.json and absent from Smithy/OpenAPI. Not part of the TypeScript modeled surface.

name: A 401 that outlives the refresh on an SDK form request is surfaced after the one resend
reason: Go-only handwritten calendar-event form update; PATCH/PUT excluded in spec/excluded-routes.json and absent from Smithy/OpenAPI. Not part of the TypeScript modeled surface.

name: GetWorkflowStage reads a stage and its threads as JSON
reason: Go, Rust, Kotlin and Swift reduce the stage to a handwritten view (staging_id, topic_id, subject, entry_count). The TypeScript generated operation returns the modeled stage JSON as HEY answers it, so the view assertions are outside its generated surface.

name: A write answered through a redirect whose hop is refused is refreshed but not sent again
reason: The TypeScript client sends every request with redirect: "manual" and follows no hop, so a write's 302 is its answer and there is no hop to be refused.
